Terrain3D._performance_target_storage.tooltip:
Purpose: Persists the selected performance-profile identity before serialized resource properties so scene loading can restore nested material overrides without reapplying the base profile afterward.
Visual: None. This is storage backing for the visible Performance Target control.
GPU: None.
CPU: Load/save-time profile restoration only; no steady-state CPU work.
Memory: None.
Change cost: Serialization/load ordering only; it delegates to the canonical Performance Target setter.
Runtime: Storage-only; unavailable as a normal authoring control.
Dependencies/conflicts: Must remain serialized before Resources while the visible Performance Target control remains in the later Performance Profile Inspector group.
Profile ownership: None
Subsystem/tier: Performance Profile / Global
State: Storage-only; visibility=hidden

Terrain3D.assets.tooltip:
Purpose: Configures Assets for the runtime streaming subsystem; the fields below state its concrete visual, CPU, GPU, memory, and change-time contract.
